reviews.x: I had high hopes for this deodorant but it hasn't worked well for me. I quit using aluminum-based deodorants several years ago because they irritate my armpits. I tried several "natural" deodorants but none worked. I eventually discovered deodorants with baking soda and those worked well. They can be a little irritating when I first put them on, which is the reason I decided to try this magnesium deodorant. It isn't irritating at all. Unfortunately, it isn't very reliable. It works on some days

reviews.t: I wanted to love this - but unfortunately it did not work well
reviews.x: I wanted to love this - but unfortunately it did not work well. Within a few hours it had already seemed to wear off. By the end of the day sitting at a desk I didn't smell nice. It also caused a small rash.

It works better than most, but I still smelled pretty gross at the end of the day. I may try other scents from them, this one smelled like a citronella candle and didn't really cover up my underarm odor. Perhaps a different one will work better with my specific scent and body chemistry. But if you're on the hunt for a good natural deodorant, this one is definitely worth a try because it doesn't cause irritation and it really does work better than a lot of the others out there. I recently received this deodorant and am already very impressed with this product after my first use at the gym. As a powerlifter, fitness instructor, and vegan, this deodorant meets all of my needs. I love the scent of "Wildwood". Furthermore, this product goes on smooth and clear. I'll be sticking to this deodorant from now on! Highly recommend.

This is actually quite a nice product, but there are two things that are displeasing. One, this will turn the underarms of your shirt a dirty yellowish brown, not cute. Two, there is very little product. It smells nice, goes on smooth and works. But there isn’t much in there.

reviews.t: The scent is nice and subtle
reviews.x: Finally a deodorant that doesn't break me out! The absense of baking soda in this is a LIFESAVER! The scent is nice and subtle. Definitely sticking with this brand!
Husband hates it and it smelled terrible

reviews.t: Best fully organic deo out there!
reviews.x: Love this product! I have been using natural deodorant for about 2 years now but have struggled with irritation from baking soda. Raw earth deo excludes baking soda which make it gentle on the pits! And it works fantastic. I apply in the morning and smell fresh all day. This does not stop sweating which is fine because sweat is natural for us humans BUT it helps keep the bacteria (what causes the smell) down. Only thing I'd like more is more scents. Normally I just grab a vegetarian and rub them in my armpits, but this works even better. I have always had issues with aluminum based antiperspirants, and this lasts most of the day and smells like fresh cut 2x4's.. I keep looking around for a construction site, but it's just my armpits. Seriously. Take a hatchet to a pine tree - this is what it smells like.  It's kind of mushy, so you have to put it on sparingly or it just clumps up in a ball. I screwed it up too high the first time and smeare

After years of trying off the shelf & online deodorants, I found something that works and works great. It feels natural & organic. I tried on weekend, incase it itched, but none of that. Absolutely no discomfort at all. It will last the whole day for me in 98+ degrees. no body odor at all in the evening or night. love it. I tried the cedarwood & lemon scent & like it.  highly recommend to buy.

reviews.t: Great natural product that smells awesome
reviews.x: My husband and I both love this brand. I use the lemon lime thyme and he uses the wildwood. They smell so good and last all day. I often have people ask me about what Body spray I’m wearing and I tell them it’s my deodorant. It’s also natural and much more healthy for you than those dangerous ones with aluminum. I’ll be buying this brand for a long time.

I’ve had this product for over a month now and I just ordered a second one !  I LOVE IT ! I’ve tried about 5 different natural deodorants in the past few months and this is by far my favorite. It’s baking soda free which is great because I don’t get itchy armpits like with other natural deodorants.

I received my deodorant and all was good the first 3 days - the scent is pleasant and it seemed to work for me....but this morning I went to turn it up..to expose more of the deodorant and it would not turn.  I cannot get anymore out of it, unless I scoop it out.  Disappointing.

Very nice smell and effective for a suitable timeframe but my stick is very dry and thus rather uncomfortable to apply. For those with sensitive skin this could be problematic. I would give a 5 star rating if the application was enhanced.

Melts in the heat even when in the cabinet and will hoop on or in the winter it crumbles so you have to keep it under your pit for a minute to heat it up. Biggest complaint is that it doesn’t last all day. You will have to re apply.

I use the lemon lime thyme scent.  It smells fresh and clean.  I haven’t tried any of the other scents.  I have tried other brands of natural deodorant and have gotten a rash.  I have not had a rash while using Raw Earth Organic.

It smells nice but it doesn't last all day and it is a bit greasy. It never stained my clothes but there is a slimy film on and around my armpit that stays even when it stops working and you start to stink again.

claims.text: Several reviewers report the deodorant wears off quickly and fails to control odor by the end of the day.
Some users experienced skin irritation or rashes from the product.
Multiple reviewers received deodorant that arrived dry and crumbled.
Many reviewers praise the scent, saying it smells nice and goes on smooth.
A few reviewers complain about staining or residue left on clothing.
